title: model_defaults
description: Schema for modules/model-serving/model_defaults.yaml — validated by check-jsonschema in pre-commit and CI.

allowed_external_models.description: Approved external model names (Azure OpenAI deployments or other providers). Every model field in external_endpoints and additional_external_endpoints must be present here.

allowed_foundation_entities.description: Approved Databricks Foundation Model entity names, exactly as returned by GET /api/2.0/serving-endpoints (hyphens and dots allowed).

external_endpoints.description: External model endpoints served via Databricks external model serving. Default provider is Azure OpenAI (openai); anthropic entries call the Anthropic API directly with a secret-referenced key.

provider.description: External model provider. openai (default) targets the Azure AI Foundry account via Entra ID; anthropic targets the Anthropic API with api_key_secret.

deployment_name.description: Azure OpenAI deployment name. Required for provider: openai; ignored for other providers.

api_key_secret.description: Databricks secret path '<scope>/<key>' holding the provider API key. Required for provider: anthropic; the secret must already exist in the workspace.

table_prefix.description: Must be a valid Unity Catalog table-name component: lowercase letters, digits, underscores, starting with a letter.

foundation_endpoints.description: Pre-provisioned `databricks-*` Foundation Model API endpoints governed in place via scripts/apply-ai-gateway.sh (rate limits + inference tables).

table_prefix.description: Per-endpoint inference table name suffix (prepended by the workspace prefix). Must be a valid Unity Catalog table-name component.

disabled_foundation_models.description: Foundation model endpoint names that are blocked workspace-wide (rate_limit = 0).

gateway_defaults.description: Default AI Gateway policy applied to every governed endpoint — consumed by modules/model-serving (Terraform-managed external endpoints, unless overridden per-workspace via model_serving_rate_limits / model_serving_guardrails) and by scripts/apply-ai-gateway.sh (pre-provisioned databricks-* endpoints).

endpoint_qpm.description: Queries per minute allowed across the whole endpoint.

endpoint_tpm.description: Optional tokens per minute allowed across the whole endpoint. Omit for no token limit.

user_qpm.description: Queries per minute allowed per user.

user_group_limits.description: Optional per-group limits (max 5 — Databricks allows at most 5 group-scoped rate limits per endpoint).

guardrails.description: Optional default AI Guardrails. Omit the whole object for no guardrails.
